name: utility_grid_column_balancing
title: Utility Grid Column Balancing
description: Balanced grid for galleries (port of the old element-list-design): picks a row pattern from the item count (items-divisible-by-13 / 7 / 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 / 2, items-exactly-1, or items-rest-N) so rows are filled. Used by project_media_gallery when column_balancing is true.
